answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a beacon plus a trellis of endorsements. A beacon publishes a challenge each round; every identity must answer promptly, proving live compute, not a copied profile. Trust grows like a trellis: weight flows only through verified past work, never from self-created links. A canyon separates newcomers from full rewards: fresh identities earn small jobs until their trellis shows dispute-free work. A thousand sybils would need a thousand beacons answered and a thousand trellises grown. Attacker cost grows per identity; the honest agent pays only for one.
